scope: Bounded pure scalar compile-time built-ins in constants and static schemas

contracts.evaluation: Existing checked Pythonic math/string helpers and scalar values; no user/service call or arbitrary Python eval
contracts.dependencies: Forward/module/local argument references participate in the iterative lexical constant graph; unused definitions, cycles and unknown names remain checked
contracts.schemas: Constants and direct static dimension/capacity/group expressions resolve before allocation and exact linked interfaces; existing bounds remain
contracts.arguments: Eager left-to-right evaluation after dependency resolution, fixed arity, finite numeric and bounded ASCII domains, no Boolean truthiness or implicit text parsing
contracts.persistence: Resolved scalar values only; generated modules never repeat compile-time calls or create runtime constant cells
contracts.metadata: Scoped function/type/origin rows, optional declaring constant and explicit call bounds/policy
contracts.limits: 4096 distinct cached evaluations per translation and 64 nested pure calls; E_CONSTANT at the source on exhaustion
contracts.exclusions: User/external routines, callbacks, services, time/system/port/register/FILE/ARRAY/geometry/resource state and Python eval; internal strict call rejection preserved
